  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to make n8n’s IT operations reliable, secure, and scalable while reducing manual work through thoughtful, maintainable automation.

You’ll combine hands-on IT operations with continuous process improvement across the following areas:

IDENTITY, ACCESS, AND SAAS OPERATIONS

  • Own day-to-day identity and access management across Okta, Google Workspace, GitHub, and connected SaaS applications.

  • Manage employee and application lifecycle workflows, including provisioning, access changes, group assignments, troubleshooting, and deprovisioning.

  • Maintain an accurate SaaS inventory and support application administration, lifecycle management, access governance, and account reconciliation.

EMPLOYEE AND ENDPOINT LIFECYCLE

  • Deliver reliable and timely onboarding and offboarding experiences in close partnership with People, Finance, managers, and application owners.

  • Manage and troubleshoot n8n’s primarily macOS device fleet through our endpoint management tooling.

  • Support hardware procurement, device lifecycle workflows, and secure endpoint operations for a growing distributed team.

AUTOMATION AND CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

  • Design and build secure automations for recurring IT processes using n8n, APIs, scripting, and AI-assisted tooling where appropriate.

  • Redesign manual workflows so they become observable, documented, reliable, and easier to operate at scale.

  • Build automations with appropriate logging, error handling, monitoring, ownership, and human approval steps for sensitive decisions.

SUPPORT, DOCUMENTATION, AND COMPLIANCE

  • Provide responsive L1/L2 IT support while using recurring issues to identify opportunities for systemic improvement.

  • Create and maintain clear runbooks, process documentation, escalation paths, and operational controls.

  • Support security and compliance activities, including access reviews, audit evidence collection, SOC 2, and ISO 27001-related processes.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🧰 Modern IT operations experience: You have 2–4 years of experience in IT systems administration, SaaS administration, IAM, workplace engineering, or a similar role within a SaaS, cloud-first, or distributed company.

  • 🔐 Identity and access management: You have hands-on experience with Google Workspace and an identity provider such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID.

  • 🔄 Employee lifecycle management: You have managed onboarding, offboarding, groups, roles, access changes, application assignments, and secure deprovisioning.

  • 💻 macOS endpoint management: You have administered macOS devices through an MDM platform such as Kandji, Jamf, JumpCloud, Workspace ONE, or a comparable tool.

  • ⚙️ Workflow automation: You can demonstrate how you have improved or automated an operational process using APIs, scripting, workflow automation platforms, or AI-assisted tooling.

  • 🔌 Integration fundamentals: You have working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication concepts, and integration troubleshooting.

  • 🔍 Technical troubleshooting: You can diagnose workflow and systems issues using logs, API responses, system events, and other operational data.

  • 🧭 Ownership and judgment: You’re known for strong ownership, sound judgment, rigor, and a thoughtful approach to privileged access, sensitive data, and high-impact changes.

  • 🤝 Service mindset: You communicate clearly, document your work thoroughly, and care about delivering a reliable experience for internal users.

  • 🌍 Autonomous working style: You’re comfortable prioritising and making progress independently in an evolving, distributed environment without relying on highly defined procedures for every task.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🔗 Workflow automation platforms: You have experience with n8n or another workflow automation platform such as Zapier or Make.

  • ⌨️ Scripting: You have basic scripting experience using Python, JavaScript, or Bash.

  • 🪪 Identity protocols: You have worked with SAML, OIDC, SSO, and SCIM.

  • 🐙 GitHub administration: You have experience managing GitHub organisations, teams, repositories, and permissions.

  • 🤖 Reliable AI workflows: You have designed AI-assisted workflows that include validation, human approvals, monitoring, error handling, and fallback paths.

  • 🛡️ Automation reliability: You understand concepts such as retries, idempotency, secrets management, auditability, and failure handling.

  • 📋 Security and compliance: You’re familiar with SOC 2, ISO 27001, access reviews, or audit evidence collection.

  • 🚀 Scaling environments: You have worked in an early-stage or rapidly growing IT function where processes and systems were still being established.

Why join us?

As the first direct report into our Senior IT Manager, you’ll have meaningful influence over how the function develops. You won’t inherit a rigid or highly bureaucratic operating model — you’ll help shape the systems, workflows, documentation, and standards that support our next stage of growth.

Your work will extend far beyond resolving tickets. You’ll operate critical IT systems, connect tools through APIs and workflows, and use n8n and AI-assisted automation to make our internal operations faster, safer, and more reliable. You’ll gain broad exposure across IAM, SaaS governance, endpoint management, security, compliance, and workplace automation while partnering closely with teams across the company.

You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first organisation that values autonomy, experimentation, strong judgment, and continuous improvement. As the IT function expands, you’ll have the opportunity to take on greater ownership across operational IAM, SaaS management, device operations, and automation.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the scalable IT foundations behind the future of automation.

EMPLOYEE AND ENDPOINT LIFECYCLE

 - Deliver reliable and timely onboarding and offboarding experiences in close partnership with People, Finance, managers, and application owners.

 - Manage and troubleshoot n8n’s primarily macOS device fleet through our endpoint management tooling.

 - Support hardware procurement, device lifecycle workflows, and secure endpoint operations for a growing distributed team.


AUTOMATION AND CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

 - Design and build secure automations for recurring IT processes using n8n, APIs, scripting, and AI-assisted tooling where appropriate.

 - Redesign manual workflows so they become observable, documented, reliable, and easier to operate at scale.

 - Build automations with appropriate logging, error handling, monitoring, ownership, and human approval steps for sensitive decisions.


SUPPORT, DOCUMENTATION, AND COMPLIANCE

 - Provide responsive L1/L2 IT support while using recurring issues to identify opportunities for systemic improvement.

 - Create and maintain clear runbooks, process documentation, escalation paths, and operational controls.

 - Support security and compliance activities, including access reviews, audit evidence collection, SOC 2, and ISO 27001-related processes.

 - 🔄 Employee lifecycle management: You have managed onboarding, offboarding, groups, roles, access changes, application assignments, and secure deprovisioning.

 - 💻 macOS endpoint management: You have administered macOS devices through an MDM platform such as Kandji, Jamf, JumpCloud, Workspace ONE, or a comparable tool.

 - ⚙️ Workflow automation: You can demonstrate how you have improved or automated an operational process using APIs, scripting, workflow automation platforms, or AI-assisted tooling.

 - 🔌 Integration fundamentals: You have working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication concepts, and integration troubleshooting.

 - 🔍 Technical troubleshooting: You can diagnose workflow and systems issues using logs, API responses, system events, and other operational data.

 - 🧭 Ownership and judgment: You’re known for strong ownership, sound judgment, rigor, and a thoughtful approach to privileged access, sensitive data, and high-impact changes.

 - 🤝 Service mindset: You communicate clearly, document your work thoroughly, and care about delivering a reliable experience for internal users.

 - 🌍 Autonomous working style: You’re comfortable prioritising and making progress independently in an evolving, distributed environment without relying on highly defined procedures for every task.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 🔗 Workflow automation platforms: You have experience with n8n or another workflow automation platform such as Zapier or Make.

 - ⌨️ Scripting: You have basic scripting experience using Python, JavaScript, or Bash.

 - 🪪 Identity protocols: You have worked with SAML, OIDC, SSO, and SCIM.

 - 🐙 GitHub administration: You have experience managing GitHub organisations, teams, repositories, and permissions.

 - 🤖 Reliable AI workflows: You have designed AI-assisted workflows that include validation, human approvals, monitoring, error handling, and fallback paths.

 - 🛡️ Automation reliability: You understand concepts such as retries, idempotency, secrets management, auditability, and failure handling.

 - 📋 Security and compliance: You’re familiar with SOC 2, ISO 27001, access reviews, or audit evidence collection.

 - 🚀 Scaling environments: You have worked in an early-stage or rapidly growing IT function where processes and systems were still being established.

Why join us?

As the first direct report into our Senior IT Manager, you’ll have meaningful influence over how the function develops. You won’t inherit a rigid or highly bureaucratic operating model — you’ll help shape the systems, workflows, documentation, and standards that support our next stage of growth.

Your work will extend far beyond resolving tickets. You’ll operate critical IT systems, connect tools through APIs and workflows, and use n8n and AI-assisted automation to make our internal operations faster, safer, and more reliable. You’ll gain broad exposure across IAM, SaaS governance, endpoint management, security, compliance, and workplace automation while partnering closely with teams across the company.

You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first organisation that values autonomy, experimentation, strong judgment, and continuous improvement. As the IT function expands, you’ll have the opportunity to take on greater ownership across operational IAM, SaaS management, device operations, and automation.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the scalable IT foundations behind the future of automation.

  • Lead go-to-market planning and execution for key launches, features, and strategic initiatives

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Marketing to ensure alignment on enterprise priorities

  • Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution across messaging, campaigns, and assets

  • Bring structure and prioritisation to enterprise PMM work, focusing on highest-impact opportunities

- Enterprise PMM becomes more strategic, proactive, and well prioritised

- Messaging is clearer and more consistent across campaigns, launches, and sales conversations

- Key enterprise initiatives are better planned and executed

- The PMM team benefits from stronger senior strategic input, not just execution

- Senior Product Marketing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally in technical products

- Strong background in enterprise PMM, including:

Positioning

Sales enablement

- Proven ability to operate as a senior IC, balancing strategy with execution

- Experience supporting complex buying cycles and enterprise customers

- Strong cross-functional collaboration with Product, Sales, and Marketing

- Excellent prioritisation and judgement across a broad scope

- Strong written communication and content development skills

- Experience in workflow automation, developer tools, infrastructure, integrations, or AI

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to empower n8n enterprise users to treat automation as software, enabling them to develop, deploy, and scale mission-critical workflows with absolute confidence.

To do so, you’ll own product strategy and execution for n8n’s Enterprise team, focused on application lifecycle management, developer tools, and production-grade workflow operations:

WORKFLOW LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT

  • Define how teams move workflows from development to production with clear environment separation and promotion paths.

  • Shape capabilities for workflow version history, rollback, branching, and conflict resolution.

  • Build product experiences that help engineering teams safely manage changes across mission-critical automations.

ENTERPRISE DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE

  • Own Git-based source control workflows that make n8n fit naturally into modern software development practices.

  • Work closely with Engineering and Design to deliver powerful yet intuitive tools for technical teams.

  • Translate complex developer workflows into product experiences that feel reliable, scalable, and easy to adopt.

PRODUCTION OPERATIONS AND OBSERVABILITY

  • Build visibility into workflow performance, usage, and reliability across environments and instances.

  • Define how enterprise teams manage external secrets, variables, and configuration across deployments.

  • Help customers operate n8n at scale through multi-instance management and cross-instance visibility.

PRODUCT DISCOVERY AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP

  • Deeply engage with enterprise customers, engineering leaders, admins, and developers to understand their software delivery needs.

  • Prioritize ruthlessly across technical depth, usability, enterprise readiness, and long-term platform leverage.

  • Align Engineering, Design, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and leadership through clear strategy, specs, and communication.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Proven product management experience: You’ve shipped complex technical products in enterprise environments and can point to lessons learned that shaped your craft.

  • Strong developer empathy: You understand how engineering teams build, test, version, deploy, and operate software in production.

  • Thrive in ambiguity: You bring structure to fuzzy technical problems and prioritize clearly across many possible directions.

  • Exceptional product sense: You anticipate edge cases, second-order effects, and enterprise-grade reliability needs without needing perfect information.

  • Ownership and bias for action: You fix what’s broken, ship, learn, and iterate rather than over-plan.

  • Influence without authority: You align engineering, design, data, sales, solutions engineering, customer success, and docs through clarity and trust.

  • Technical product judgment: You’re comfortable making tradeoffs across usability, scalability, security, reliability, and implementation complexity.

Nice-to-haves

  • Git and source control experience: You’ve worked on or closely with products involving Git, branching, versioning, pull requests, or conflict resolution.

  • Enterprise security experience: You understand secrets management, environment variables, access control, or secure configuration patterns.

  • Observability experience: You’ve worked on products involving monitoring, usage insights, performance visibility, or operational dashboards.

  • Coding or SQL skills: You can code, write SQL, or go deep enough technically to partner effectively with engineers on architecture-level discussions.

  • Remote work experience: You’re familiar with remote-first work environments and can collaborate effectively across time zones.

  • Entrepreneurial or early-stage experience: You’ve worn many hats and can navigate in many areas at once.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a slide deck. You’ll shape how engineering teams build, version, deploy, and operate mission-critical automations at scale — turning n8n into the platform where automation is treated with the same rigor as software. You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first team with high autonomy, strong technical ambition, and direct visibility into enterprise customer impact.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

We are looking for a highly technical educator and problem-solver to be the technical anchor of our Scaled Enterprise CS team (€20k–50k ARR segment). As a complex, developer-focused platform, n8n requires deep architectural understanding. In this individual contributor role, you won't be managing a traditional 1:1 book of business. Instead, you will act as the "technical unblocker" for hundreds of Enterprise customers simultaneously. You will design and lead one-to-many technical enablement sessions, host live office hours, build advanced workflow templates, and step in for strategic, targeted interventions when our automated systems flag an account that is struggling with architecture or node configurations.

What you'll do

  • Run the technical programs. Lead weekly office hours, monthly deep-dive webinars on the patterns enterprise customers actually struggle with: error handling, AI agents, self-hosting at scale, security and governance, and best practices, lead demos in the weekly group onboarding calls

  • Own the enterprise Slack channel. Be the technical expert in the room — triage, answer, escalate to Product when needed, and turn recurring threads into reusable content.

  • Help with implementation. Jump into activation calls when a customer is stuck. You're not the end-to-end implementation owner — you're the technical assistant that unblocks them and gets them back to self-serve.

  • Partner with other teams to build the playbooks.

    • Reference workflows, integration patterns, security/governance guides, migration guides, AI agent patterns. The library you build is what makes the segment scale.

    • Translate the common questions and hurdles you see in Office Hours/webinars into reusable technical assets.

    • Build advanced use-case templates, video tutorials, and technical documentation that the Digital CS team can distribute in automated campaigns.

  • Build internal automations. When the CS team needs an n8n workflow to automate something internally — health-score triggers, lifecycle alerts, Slack ↔ Vitally syncs — you build it. Best dogfooding in the company.

  • Drive retention through technical health. Identify accounts whose technical setup is fragile (single point of failure, no error handling, scaling issues, brittle credentials) and intervene before that becomes a renewal conversation.

  • Product Feedback Loop. Act as the voice of the scaled technical user. Synthesize the friction points you observe in live sessions and feed them back to the Product and Engineering teams to improve the core n8n experience.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Location: Rights to work in Europe or willingness to relocate to Germany.

  • 💼 Relevant Background: 3–5+ years as a high-performing individual contributor in Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management (TAM), Technical Onboarding, or Developer Advocacy within a B2B SaaS environment.

  • ⚙️ Technical Skillset: Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, JSON, JavaScript, and workflow automation. You understand how backend systems talk to each other and can troubleshoot complex integrations on the fly.

  • 🗣 The "Educator" Skillset: Exceptional presentation and communication skills. You are highly charismatic and comfortable commanding a room (or a Zoom call) of 50+ engineers, developers, or ops leaders, breaking down complex concepts into digestible pieces.

  • 🌱 Scalable Mindset: You possess deep empathy for builders and developers. You have a "solve it once, document it for everyone" mentality, constantly looking for ways to turn a 1:1 solution into a 1-to-many asset.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🎓 Technical degree (e.g., Computer Science, Machine Learning, etc.)

  • 🤖 Hands-on experience with n8n is a massive plus

Why join us? At n8n, you’ll help shape how Customer Success scales at one of Europe’s fastest-growing startups. You’ll have a direct impact on how we support, retain, and grow our Enterprise customers—acting as the ultimate technical unblocker and building the enablement engines that make deep technical success repeatable.

You’ll join a remote-first, highly cross-functional team that values ownership, experimentation, and practical problem-solving. This is a role for someone who wants to blend deep technical architecture with one-to-many education, helping n8n scale from strong customer relationships to a world-class customer experience.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on? Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

  • Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.

  • Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

 

SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE

  • Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.

MAJOR RELEASES & CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

  • Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.

  • Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.

  • Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

Must-haves

  • Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.

  • Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

  • Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments

 

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

  • Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.

  • Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.

  • Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

  • Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to own the forward-looking financial plan for n8n’s commercial engine and help Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships make sharper, data-driven investment decisions.

To make that happen, you’ll co-own the GTM plan, turn commercial strategy into actionable financial insight, and build the models and operating rhythms that support n8n’s next stage of growth:

DRIVE GTM PLANNING AND FORECASTING

  • Lead n8n’s annual planning and regular forecasting process for GTM, from top-down target setting and cross-functional alignment through to consolidation into the company plan.

  • Build and maintain an integrated sales-led top-line model that reflects the evolving strategies of Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships.

  • Partner with other FP&A Managers and Controlling to ensure the company’s forward plan and actual performance are connected, consistent, and interpreted with rigor.

MODEL COMMERCIAL PERFORMANCE

  • Model pipeline health, sales dynamics, funnel economics, and enterprise sales performance to help leadership understand the drivers behind growth.

  • Translate key growth levers such as pipeline generation, conversion, and ACV into clear financial impact and investment trade-offs.

  • Support pricing and packaging analysis, including the impact of commercial decisions on revenue and margin.

PARTNER WITH GTM LEADERSHIP

  • Own the financial partnership with GTM budget owners, helping them right-size investment and make informed decisions before committing resources.

  • Define the KPIs, reporting cadence, and frameworks that improve decision-making, including a consistent approach to marketing ROI, CAC, conversion, and marketing-sourced bookings.

  • Present clear, concise recommendations to Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive leadership, including board-level audiences when required.

STRENGTHEN GTM FINANCE OPERATIONS

  • Partner with RevOps on capacity planning, funnel performance, and the financial implications of GTM strategy.

  • Work with Data and Controlling to turn GTM financial reporting into tangible insight and recommendations rather than simply explaining variances.

  • Partner with RevOps and Controlling to forecast sales commission expense as part of the overall GTM budget.

  • Use AI and automation to create repeatable, scalable planning and reporting workflows that reflect how an automation company should operate.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 📊 FP&A expertise: You have 7+ years of experience in FP&A or strategic finance, ideally within a fast-paced technology or B2B SaaS environment.

  • 🗂️ Complex planning leadership: You have led multi-entity, multi-stakeholder annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes from end to end.

  • 🤝 GTM business partnering: You have partnered closely with Sales and Marketing leaders, ideally supporting a sales-led growth or enterprise sales motion.

  • 📈 Enterprise sales economics: You are fluent in CAC, CAC payback, CLV-to-CAC, pipeline dynamics, funnel conversion, and the economics of enterprise growth.

  • 🧮 Financial modeling: You build sophisticated, integrated financial models that remain reliable as assumptions and business conditions change.

  • 🗣️ Executive communication: You turn complex financial analysis into clear recommendations and are comfortable presenting to GTM leaders, executives, and board audiences.

  • 🤖 AI- and automation-first mindset: You actively use AI and automation platforms such as n8n to improve the quality, speed, and repeatability of your work.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🎓 Relevant education: You have a degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

  • 🏦 Transaction experience: You started your career in transaction advisory, investment banking, or a similarly analytical environment.

  • 🐍 Python skills: You are comfortable using Python to automate modeling, analysis, or reporting workflows.

  • 🧩 Planning platforms: You have worked with financial or headcount planning platforms such as Pigment in complex, multi-entity environments.

  • ☁️ CRM familiarity: You have experience using Salesforce or similar RevOps tooling as a data consumer.

  • 🗄️ SQL capability: You can use SQL or another query language to retrieve and shape data independently.

  • 🌱 PLG familiarity: You understand product-led growth metrics and motions and can collaborate effectively with PLG and R&D finance counterparts.

  • 📊 BI experience: You have worked with dashboarding or BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.

  • ⚙️ Relevant industry exposure: You have experience in workflow automation, developer tools, infrastructure software, or a related SaaS category.

  • 🌍 Distributed collaboration: You are comfortable working in a distributed, async-first team with a high degree of autonomy.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll directly shape the financial plan behind our enterprise growth motion, with real visibility into sales strategy, marketing investment, and the decisions that determine how we scale. You’ll work closely with GTM leaders, RevOps, Data, Controlling, and a counterpart FP&A Manager covering PLG and R&D, giving you broad influence across the company’s forward plan.

As n8n continues to grow rapidly and expands its role in AI agent orchestration, you’ll help ensure that every major commercial investment is connected to measurable financial outcomes. You’ll join a remote-first, ambitious team that values autonomy, rigorous thinking, experimentation, and using automation to improve how work gets done.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the financial foundations for the future of automation.

Our company language is English.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to shape and evolve the core platform architecture that powers n8n — creating scalable, configurable foundations across execution, infrastructure, and frontend platform so 80+ product engineers and our open-source community can build confidently across cloud and self-hosted deployments.

Working across our platform teams, you’ll bring architectural coherence to the systems they jointly own and help us make the right long-term technical decisions as n8n scales:

Architectural direction across Core Platform

  • Drive architecture across the two Core Platform teams, ensuring execution, infrastructure, data, and frontend platform systems evolve as a coherent whole rather than independent components.

  • Design highly adaptable backend foundations that support different workloads, deployment models, shared product team needs, and future scale without creating unnecessary complexity.

  • Partner with the FE platform workstream on core canvas architecture, real-time communication, performance, plugin contracts, and other platform primitives used by product teams.

Execution, distributed systems & data foundations

  • Evolve core subsystems including durable workflow execution and state, orchestration, queue and task distribution, worker management, scheduling, and horizontal scaling.

  • Design for correctness and resilience across distributed environments, including failure modes, idempotency, state transitions, tenant isolation, and reliability guarantees.

  • Shape our data and persistence architecture, including database scaling, sharding, migration strategies, deployment abstractions, and long-term operational maintainability.

Platform architecture & engineering enablement

  • Lead consequential technical decisions through clear proposals and RFCs, making trade-offs explicit and aligning engineers and stakeholders around durable solutions.

  • Define stable platform interfaces and abstractions that reduce coupling, support safe migrations, and make the platform easier for feature teams to build on.

  • Mentor engineers across all engineering teams through design reviews, pairing, and technical guidance, raising the bar for architecture, system design, and maintainability.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🏗️ Staff-level architectural ownership: You have a track record of leading architecture across multiple systems or teams, including migrations, re-architectures, or foundational platform initiatives with long-term organizational impact.

  • 🧠 Systems thinking: You reason deeply about invariants, correctness, failure modes, boundaries, and trade-offs, and you’re comfortable making decisions where there is no obviously perfect solution.

  • ⚙️ Configurable systems at scale: You’ve designed highly configurable, adaptable systems that serve multiple use cases or operating modes without becoming brittle or excessively complex.

  • 🌐 Distributed systems depth: You’ve designed and operated distributed systems involving concepts such as asynchronous processing, idempotency, state machines, queues, consistency, and resilience.

  • 🗄️ Data architecture at scale: You’ve worked on data-intensive systems where persistence, performance, isolation, migrations, and operational reliability were meaningful architectural concerns.

  • 🛠️ TypeScript & Node.js depth: You have strong TypeScript experience and have built substantial backend systems with Node.js beyond conventional CRUD applications.

  • 🤝 Cross-team technical leadership: You influence through technical judgment, clear communication, RFCs, design reviews, and mentorship, helping multiple teams converge on better solutions without relying on formal authority.

  • 🧱 Platform enablement mindset: You care about creating clear contracts, abstractions, and developer experiences that allow other engineers to move faster and more safely.

  • 🧹 Long-horizon engineering: You’re energized by modularization, migrations, refactoring, and evolving existing systems while keeping the product and engineering organization moving.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🧰 Workflow, orchestration or devtools experience: You’ve worked on workflow engines, orchestration platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure-heavy SaaS products.

  • 🖥️ Frontend platform architecture: You’ve worked with architecture-heavy frontend systems such as canvas applications, plugin systems, real-time applications, web workers, or complex rendering environments.

  • 🧾 Durable execution patterns: You’ve designed or operated systems using event sourcing, sagas, durable execution, or related state-management patterns.

  • 👥 Multi-tenant architecture: You’ve designed systems where tenant isolation, resource management, data boundaries, or noisy-neighbour concerns were important.

  • 🌍 Open-source experience: You’ve contributed to or maintained open-source software and understand the additional pressure around public contracts and backward compatibility.

  • 📈 Large-scale SaaS exposure: You’ve operated systems at meaningful scale or worked in environments where reliability and architectural decisions had broad customer impact.

  • 🧩 Monolith → modular migrations: You’ve decomposed monolithic systems or led incremental architectural migrations without preventing product teams from continuing to ship.

  • ☁️ Multi-deployment awareness: You’ve designed products that need to work consistently across both managed cloud and self-hosted environments.

  • 🔭 Observability mindset: You think about instrumentation, debugging, incident response, rollout safety, and operability as part of system design rather than an afterthought.

  • 🧪 Strong CS grounding: You bring deep knowledge of distributed systems concepts, consistency models, consensus, formal methods, or similarly rigorous approaches to system correctness.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll work on the foundations that almost every product experience depends on. You’ll have influence across two Core Platform teams, helping shape how our execution engine, infrastructure, data architecture, and frontend platform evolve together as both our product and engineering organization scale.

This is a Staff role with real architectural leverage: you’ll tackle problems that span team boundaries, evolve systems that already operate at meaningful scale, and create platform capabilities that make 80+ engineers more effective. You’ll do that in a remote-first environment that values autonomy, thoughtful experimentation, and engineers who influence through strong technical judgment rather than hierarchy.

Sound like the kind of platform challenge you want to own?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

About the role

n8n is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to own and grow a defined enterprise territory across Northern Europe (UK&I, Nordics & Benelux) building pipeline, landing net-new logos, and expanding strategic accounts.

You’ll run a full-cycle, consultative enterprise motion (FTE 2,500+): uncovering technical and business needs, aligning multiple stakeholders, guiding evaluations, and closing high-impact six/seven-figure deals.

This role is ideal for someone who can sell to technical buyers (developers are our ICP), thrives in fast-growing environments, and uses a structured methodology (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDDPICC) to drive predictable outcomes.

🧭 Build pipeline proactively (≥50%+ sourced by you) through outbound prospecting and smart territory/account planning

🔎 Run deep discovery and qualification using MEDDIC/MEDDPICC—uncovering pain, impact, decision process, decision criteria, and confirming real evidence before you forecast

🧱 Manage the full sales cycle end-to-end: discovery, demos, technical validation/evaluation, proposals, procurement, and negotiations

🧠 Translate technical value into business outcomes—aligning n8n’s automation + AI capabilities to measurable efficiency, risk reduction, and speed-to-delivery

🤝 Orchestrate multi-threaded deals across stakeholders (champions, technical evaluators, security, procurement, and economic buyers) to keep momentum and reduce stall risk

📝 Create and drive mutual action plans with customers—clear next steps, milestones, and shared accountability from first meeting to signature

📈 Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene, forecast accuracy, and account notes in CRM (Salesforce) communicating clearly and early about risks and next steps

🔗 Partner tightly with Solutions Engineering, SDRs, Marketing, RevOps, and Customer Success to accelerate deals and ensure strong handoffs for expansion

🌍 Represent n8n at events and in-market—building credibility with technical communities and enterprise leaders across Northern Europe (with customer travel as needed)

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

🏆 Enterprise SaaS sales track record: 5+ years in quota-carrying roles with consistent overachievement in enterprise segments

🌍 Northern Europe market expertise: Existing network and proven success selling into Northern Europe enterprises (plus relevant languages)

🧩 Complex deal leadership: Proven ability to close multi-stakeholder deals with longer cycles, procurement/legal steps, and high scrutiny

🔎 Methodology-driven execution (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC): You use structured qualification to build high-confidence pipeline and accurate forecasts

🗣️ Executive + technical buyer fluency: You can engage C-level stakeholders and also win credibility with technical audiences (DevOps, SecOps, IT Ops etc.)

🧠 Consultative selling: You lead with customer outcomes, ask sharp questions, and tailor your narrative to the customer’s reality—not a generic pitch

📊 Operational discipline: Strong CRM hygiene, forecast rigor, and a habit of using evidence to drive next steps and internal alignment

🤝 Collaboration mindset: You work smoothly with SE/CS/Marketing/RevOps and elevate the whole deal team, not just your own activity

Nice-to-haves

🧑‍💻 Open-source / community experience: You’ve sold in or alongside open-source ecosystems and understand bottoms-up adoption and PLG signals

🧪 Selling technical workflow/automation products: Experience with integration, API-first platforms, DevOps/SecOps/IT Ops, or adjacent categories

🚀 Early-stage / scale-up experience: You’ve helped build pipeline and playbooks in a fast-growing environment where process is evolving

You'll report directly to our senior commercial leadership, inherit a small enablement team with basic onboarding in place, and have the mandate (and explicit VP trajectory) to build the function from the ground up: for a remote-first company selling across EMEA, the US, and beyond.

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

METHODOLOGY & ENTERPRISE SELLING EXCELLENCE

  • Own the global install of one enterprise methodology (MEDDICC / value-selling framework): selection, rollout, certification, and continuous reinforcement across every rep and manager, in every region.

  • Build the PLG-to-enterprise playbook: teach sellers to convert community and self-serve signals into qualified 7-figure pipeline.

BUILDING THE GLOBAL FUNCTION

  • Lead and grow the enablement team (starting with 1–2 ICs) across sales, SDR, CS, and partner enablement.

  • Stand up the enablement infrastructure: tooling, content systems, certification tracking, and measurement with RevOps.

  • Operate as a trusted peer to regional sales leaders across EMEA, the US, and future markets: in deal rooms, QBRs, and forecast reviews.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🚀 Hypergrowth pedigree: You built enablement at a developer-tool, open-source, or technical B2B SaaS company as it scaled enterprise.

  • 📈 €xm→€1bn scaling: You grew the function through a major GTM headcount wave and constant evolution of sales maturity. You've solved ramp at volume, not maintained steady-state.

  • 🎖️ Methodology-firm pedigree: Force Management, or similar as a consultant or a certified in-house champion.

  • 💼 Carried a bag: You sold enterprise deals yourself, so reps and leaders trust you in deal conversations.

  • 🌱 PLG-to-enterprise: You've enabled teams converting community/self-serve momentum into enterprise revenue.

We’re looking for a Customer Success Lead to manage our Guided and High Touch Customer Success Managers across the West and Central regions. This role reports to the Global VP of Customer Success.

At n8n, Customer Success is mission-critical. Our customers are builders: developers, ops teams, and innovators automating their workflows and scaling their impact through n8n. Ensuring they can implement our solution effectively and realize its full value isn’t just a nice-to-have, it’s what will keep them growing with us for years to come.

We’re in the exciting stage of scaling out the Customer Success function: maturing our playbooks, shaping customer journeys, and building the foundation for scalable growth.

We’re looking for someone who can lead by example - a strategic thinker with strong leadership skills who’s also eager to roll up their sleeves and build alongside the team. You’ll have the opportunity to design processes, work directly with customers, and help shape how n8n delivers value at scale.

If you thrive in an environment where ownership, creativity, and impact go hand in hand, this is your chance to help define what Customer Success means in one of the most exciting automation companies in the world.

🎯 Your main goal will be to recruit, develop, and lead a team of high-touch Customer Success Managers supporting n8n’s most strategic customers. You’ll play a key role in building the CS function from the ground up - designing the processes, playbooks, and automations that drive customer value and scale.

You’ll also represent n8n as a customer-facing leader, partnering closely with teams across Sales, Product, and Support to ensure a seamless customer journey and long-term success.

HANDS-ON BUSINESS LEADERSHIP

  • Develop a deep understanding of our customers and what drives their success. Build and refine our processes, playbooks, and automations that enable the team to deliver maximum customer impact efficiently and at scale.

  • Own territory planning for CSMs, balancing current priorities with a forward view of business, territory, and talent needs 1-2 quarters ahead.

  • Establish a strong operating cadence that keeps the team focused on top customer priorities and ensures risks or blockers receive the right internal attention.

PEOPLE MANAGEMENT

  • Attracts, develops, and empower top talent to meet customer needs and deliver on team and company goals.

  • Drive productivity by embedding automation and scalable practices that help CSMs focus on high-value work and measurable outcomes.

  • Understand each team member’s strengths and growth areas; provide regular feedback, maintain clear development plans, and support meaningful career progression.

STAKEHOLDER PARTNERSHIP AND COMMUNICATION

  • Build trusted, collaborative partnerships with Sales, Product, and Support, ensuring Customer Success is tightly aligned across the business.

  • Serve as the voice of the customer internally - advocating constructively, influencing decisions, and clearing obstacles for both the team and our customers.

  • Handle conflict and complex conversations with clarity and empathy, seeking to uncover root causes and drive progress.

  • Communicate ideas and direction with transparency and conviction, helping the team understand the why and how behind company and departmental changes.

OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

  • Establish an operating rhythm that provides predictability for the business - ensuring visibility into onboarding progress, value realization, and customer risk at the right time and to the right audience.

  • Use data to inspect and improve performance, analyzing trends, identifying insights, and coaching the team to continuously raise the bar.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

👥 2+ years of people management experience - hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing ICs

💼 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Professional Services, Account Management, or other customer-facing roles, including supporting large enterprises

🤝 Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with internal and external stakeholders

💻 Tech industry experience and relevant subject-matter expertise

🎯 Bachelor’s degree+, preferably in a technical or engineering field

Nice-to-haves

🌍 Experience leading remote teams across multiple regions and/or countries

🤖 Automation curiosity: You’re familiar with AI and automation tools, bonus points if you’ve played around with n8n!

🚀 Startup or scale-up experience: Comfortable operating in fast-changing, high-growth environments
🎯 Bachelor’s degree+, preferably in a technical or engineering field
